# Step - e

`e` · `E` · category: [Start](../../traversal/step_reference.md#start)

Starts at the edges of the graph, all or the ones with the given ids.

## Forms

```text
e()
e(arg1: any)
e(arg1: array)
e(arg1: any, arg2: any)
e(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.e().has_label("created").count().next()   // 4
```
